SELECT 
    ti.transmode AS mode_name,
    AVG(sd.handleevents) AS avg_handling_quality,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ti.vehiclereg) AS vehicles_in_stable_transport,
    COUNT(sd.sensortrack) AS count_of_reliable_instances
FROM 
    transportinfo ti
JOIN 
    sensordata sd ON ti.vehiclereg = sd.vehsenseref
WHERE 
    sd."Stable Transport" = TRUE
GROUP BY 
    ti.transmode
ORDER BY 
    avg_handling_quality DESC
LIMIT 10;
